subject.title: fix(plugins): let URL parse errors propagate in shouldRequireManifestInstallSourceRef

question: Should a malformed explicit or profile-derived marketplace feed URL fail the catalog operation immediately, or retain the current conservative strict-manifest and documented refresh-fallback behavior?
rationale: The patch changes compatibility behavior in a signed plugin catalog policy path, and the existing tests and proof do not establish which failure contract maintainers intend for upgrades and unpinned refreshes.

options.title: Prove fail-fast at the boundary
options.body: Validate URLs in the canonical source resolver, add both malformed-URL regression cases, and provide redacted runtime output showing the actionable error and intended fallback behavior.

options.title: Retain conservative handling
options.body: Keep the predicate non-throwing and improve diagnostics at the earlier configuration or feed-resolution boundary without changing catalog verification behavior.

recommendation.title: Prove fail-fast at the boundary
recommendation.body: Validate URLs in the canonical source resolver, add both malformed-URL regression cases, and provide redacted runtime output showing the actionable error and intended fallback behavior.
